_who_built: 指揮席（Claude Code conductor）。一手（車隊官方新聞稿）與官方（F1 官網）兩份來源逐字取原文，所有自有資料數字由 data/f1/db.sqlite（L1，含 2026 年第 12 站）現算，成品值寫在本檔。
thesis: 同一則續約消息裡，諾里斯在麥拉倫的年資有兩種算法：車隊從 2017 年的青年車手計畫算起說是 9 年，F1 官網從 2019 年的正賽席位算起說合約走完是 12 年。兩個都成立，差別在算的是進公司還是上車。同一天還有第二組雙口徑：官方說他為麥拉倫出賽 163 場，本站車手頁寫 164 站——差在 2026 年中國站他登錄了但沒有起跑。這篇把這份合約放回可查證的資料裡：兩種口徑各自的算法、他在麥拉倫史上出賽榜的位置，以及被官方媒體拿來對照的那個 12 年（漢米爾頓在賓士的 12 個賽季）長度相同、內容不同。
_structure_hint: 從『同一天、同一個人，數字有兩套』這個具體的怪事切進去（9 年／12 年、163／164） → 合約到底寫了什麼、官方沒說什麼（金額、起算日、2031 之後） → 把 163 場放回麥拉倫史上出賽榜（David Coulthard 150、巴頓 136、哈基寧 131） → 那個被拿來對照的 12 年：漢米爾頓在賓士（246 場、84 勝、6 冠）對照諾里斯目前的 8 季（163 場、13 勝、1 冠），長度相同內容不同，且麥拉倫上一位車手世界冠軍就是漢米爾頓（2008），到 2025 年相隔 17 年 → 簽約當下的積分現況（截至第 12 站第 4 名 159 分、領先者安東內利 242 分）只陳述不解釋動機 → 隊友與對手的合約年限 → 常見問題 → 資料來源。

mclaren_press_release.title: Reigning World Champion Lando Norris extends contract with McLaren Mastercard Formula 1 Team until at least the end of 2030

verbatim.core: Lando Norris, the 2025 Formula 1 Drivers' World Champion, has extended his contract with the McLaren Mastercard Formula 1 Team until at least 2030, with a multi-year option to commit beyond that date.
verbatim.career: Lando, 26, from Somerset, United Kingdom, is a homegrown talent who first joined McLaren nine years ago through the team's junior programme in 2017, when he held the role of Test and Simulator Driver. He was promoted to a race seat in 2019 and has since raced in 163 Grands Prix for the team, more than any other McLaren driver in history. In that time, he has secured 18 Pole positions, 48 podiums, 13 wins, two Constructors' Championships and the Drivers' World Championship.
verbatim.announcement: This extension, announced by Lando in person to the team today at the McLaren Technology Centre during the annual family and friends open day, provides further stability for the team. This follows Oscar Piastri's contract extension in March last year, while CEO Zak Brown and Team Principal Andrea Stella have both signed long-term contracts in the last two years.
verbatim.gift: In addition to confirming his future with McLaren for at least the next four years, Lando will be gifted an MCL39, which he raced during his 2025 World Championship-winning season.
verbatim.gift_reason: This gift serves as a lasting reminder of his contribution to the team, in particular his part in securing the team's second consecutive Constructors' title in 2025, while also becoming the team's first Formula 1 Drivers' World Champion since 2008.
verbatim.quote_norris: "McLaren is my home, and I'm very pleased to be signing a new contract to keep me with the team until at least 2030. When I started this journey nine years ago, I was clear about the goals I wanted to achieve: to get McLaren back to the front and to win Championships. We've achieved that goal, but we want more; we want to keep on winning, and we know as a team that we're capable of achieving it. I can't wait to get back in the car in Monza, and I'm very excited about what the future holds for us, both over the rest of this season, and in the coming years."
verbatim.quote_stella: "Lando has been an integral part of McLaren's journey and success over the last nine years, and we are delighted to continue our partnership with him through to at least 2030. He is an exceptional driver, someone who combines outstanding natural speed with maturity, consistency and a strong commitment to McLaren, but above all, he is a special human being who is valued by everyone in the team."
verbatim.quote_brown: "I'm incredibly pleased to be signing a new contract with Lando, extending his commitment with McLaren until at least 2030. His journey with the team is a fantastic example of our commitment to identifying, developing and supporting world-class talent, and his achievements speak for themselves. Together with Andrea, Oscar and the wider team, Lando has helped drive McLaren into a new papaya era of success, helping us go from the back of the grid, to double consecutive Constructors' titles in 2024 and 2025 and our first Drivers' Championship in 17 years."

mclaren_press_release._writer_note: ⛔ 引用時保留官方措辭 at least（至少到 2030 年）與 multi-year option（多年選擇權），不得寫成「簽到 2030 年」或「五年約」。⛔ Championships 一詞在引言裡是複數泛稱，不可換算成具體座數。

formula1_com.title: Norris commits future to McLaren as he signs new deal until the end of 2030

verbatim.core: Lando Norris has committed his future to McLaren after signing a new deal that will extend his stay at the British team until at least the end of 2030, with a multi-year option to commit beyond that date.
verbatim.career: The Briton joined McLaren in 2017 as a test and development driver before earning promotion to the grid as a race driver for 2019.
verbatim.stats: The 26-year-old has since gone on to claim 13 Grand Prix victories, 18 pole positions and 48 podiums – as well as his maiden World Championship in 2025. Additionally he has now raced in 163 Grands Prix for the team, more than any other McLaren driver in history.
verbatim.previous_deal: His previous deal is believed to have been set to expire at the end of 2027, but McLaren moved to lock him down for the foreseeable future with a fresh contract extension.
verbatim.hamilton_comparison: By the end of the current agreement, Norris will be 31 and have spent 12 years with McLaren, matching the stint Lewis Hamilton achieved with Mercedes.
verbatim.verstappen: His deal expires at the same time as his rival and friend Max Verstappen, who recently committed to Red Bull, whom he joined in 2016, until the end of 2030
verbatim.piastri: Norris' team mate Oscar Piastri, meanwhile, is contracted with McLaren up until the end of 2028, having signed a fresh deal ahead of the 2025 campaign. That gives McLaren stability for at least the next two Formula 1 campaigns.

own_data._grade: 本站自有資料（L1 sqlite，由 jolpica-f1 快照決定性重建）
own_data.scope: 涵蓋範圍＝一級方程式世界錦標賽 1950 年起的分站賽事；非錦標賽賽事、青年車手計畫、測試與模擬器工作皆不在資料庫內。
own_data.method: 勝場以 position_text='1' 計；頒獎台以 position_text 為 1、2、3 計；『登錄』＝該場有參賽紀錄列，『起跑』＝登錄場次扣掉未起跑者，未起跑的判定＝該場完成圈數為 0，且名次欄記為 W（退出）或狀態明寫未起跑。
own_data.method_calibration: 這個起跑口徑的每一個判定點都對過個案：Michael Schumacher 1996 年法國站（暖胎圈引擎故障）、哈基寧 1995 年澳洲站（排位賽事故未出賽）與 2001 年法國站（暖胎圈變速箱故障）、巴頓 2015 年巴林站（起跑前 ERS 故障）、普羅斯特 1980 年南非站（練習賽受傷）、勒克萊爾 2021 年摩納哥站（傳動軸故障，自桿位未能起跑）——這些都是登錄後沒有起跑。以本口徑重算 Michael Schumacher 在法拉利＝180 場，與賓士官方新聞稿載明的紀錄由來一致；重算漢米爾頓在賓士＝246 場，與賓士官方數字一致；重算諾里斯在麥拉倫＝163 場，與麥拉倫官方新聞稿一致。
own_data.method_boundary: 已揭露的邊界：「起跑後隨即退出、資料庫記為 0 圈」的個案（例：普羅斯特 1989 年澳洲站）會被算成未起跑，新舊兩種判定方式都一樣。本站不宣稱這一欄等同官方統計，正文必須就此加註。
own_data.as_of: 2026 年第 12 站荷蘭站（2026-08-23）結束後，與官方新聞稿發布時（2026-08-29）的區間內沒有其他分站。

voice._why: 只給事實不給聲音，寫手會回到預設的報告腔。
voice.reference: 小 Lin 說＋張泉靈：從具體的怪事切進去、短句、不在正文裡解釋自己的方法論。
voice.headline_style: 小標本身就是一句事實，不是分類標籤。例：『同一天，他的年資有兩種算法』可以；『一、合約內容分析』不行。
voice.forbidden_meta: 禁止把本站的查證紀律寫進正文。『這是官方新聞稿的說法，本站不替它加碼，也不換算成新台幣，那樣只會製造一個查無出處的假精確數字』→『官方沒有公布金額』。『本站資料庫的涵蓋範圍是世界錦標賽，因此以下數字均以此為界，且本站不對非錦標賽賽事做任何主張』→『本站資料庫只涵蓋世界錦標賽』。
voice.referent_policy: 禁止不具體的指代。發稿前 grep『那次』『這件事』『這個安排』『前面講的』『後者』，一律換成具體名詞（哪一站、哪一年、哪一個人）。

must_not_claim: 不可把 at least the end of 2030（至少到 2030 年底）寫成『簽到 2030 年』或『5 年約』——官方措辭是至少，且另有多年選擇權。
不可寫出任何合約金額、薪資、估值或幣別——兩份官方文件都沒有，任何數字都會是編的。
不可把 F1 官網『據信原合約到 2027 年底』寫成確定事實，引用時要保留推測語氣並標明是 F1 官網的說法。
不可解釋或推測續約的動機、談判過程、誰主動、有沒有其他車隊接觸——官方沒說，本站也沒有來源。
不可把 2026 年的積分落後與這份合約做因果連結（例如『因為衛冕不順所以簽長約』）。
不可寫『衛冕失敗』『衛冕無望』『無緣衛冕』——2026 賽季尚未結束。
不可用無名歸因：專家認為、業界人士指出、有分析認為、消息人士、據了解、外界普遍認為，全部禁用（verify-sources 會擋）。
不可宣稱諾里斯是麥拉倫史上效力最久的車手——以賽季數計目前是 8 季，David Coulthard 與哈基寧各 9 季；只有出賽場次是目前最多。
不可把桿位 18 次寫成本站算出來的——2026 年第 11、12 站排位資料尚未進本站資料庫，這個數字掛官方。
不可自行計算任何數字（年數差、場次差、勝率、每季平均）——需要的成品值都在本檔，沒有的就不要寫。
不可使用官方 logo、車隊塗裝、車手肖像或任何官方素材描述；封面與插圖一律自製資料視覺。
不可把漢米爾頓在賓士的 12 季與諾里斯的合約長度寫成成就對照（84 勝對 13 勝之類的優劣判斷）——F1 官網做的對照只有任期長度這一項。
不可宣稱這份合約讓諾里斯成為麥拉倫史上任期最長的車手——那要等合約真的走完，寫成假設句並標明前提。
不可寫皮亞斯特里的合約年限是麥拉倫官方宣布的——麥拉倫 2025 年 3 月那份官方稿只寫多年（multi-year），2028 這個年份出自 F1 官網與媒體。
不可寫漢米爾頓加入麥拉倫青年車手計畫的確切年份——官方措辭只有將近 10 年（nearly 10 years），本站沒有可驗證的一手出處。
不可寫維斯塔潘那份合約含選擇權或退出條款——紅牛官方稿與 F1 官網稿都沒有提到。
不可寫本季剩餘站數（剩下 N 站）——推算值最容易腐蝕，本站另有跨頁一致性 gate 在盯這個數字。
不可推算諾里斯到 2030 年會累積多少場出賽、多少勝或多少積分——未來賽曆與結果都是未知數。
